name: Navigation, Workbenches, Draft State, Undo, Responsive UI
transaction_boundaries: UI interaction/navigation/query-cache/Undo state is non-authoritative client state.
Recoverable working-copy checkpoint/discard uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork/receipt and never calls owning-domain mutation.
Accepted domain changes always use owning packet command with current revision/fingerprint; LLD-10 writes no other domain tables.
Deliberate-hold completion uses LLD-12 session-bound challenge/proof endpoints with mutation-grade anti-forgery, but proof never authorizes an owner command by itself.
Safe Undo invokes only an owning packet's explicitly registered inverse/correction command after fresh owner preview; LLD-10 has no global rollback writer.
failure_modes: working-copy persistence failure preserves in-memory edit without false success
stale accepted revision enters conflict review, never LWW
hold cancellation/route/target/proof failure submits no owner command
missing required browser capability disables affected interaction
owner-indeterminate action or unregistered/stale/blocked safe inverse fails closed
Communication panel provider failure is visible and never replaced by copied/stale body authority
review_evidence: HLD-11 interaction-state, working-copy, responsive, confirmation/accessibility authority imported without domain-authority transfer.
Frontend framework/build stack selected at LLD layer.
Working-copy persistence has exact command/query/route/audit contracts with 5-second idle/30-second minimum checkpoint cadence.
Safe Undo is standardized as an explicit owner opt-in inverse-preview/exact-command contract; absent or indeterminate inverse registration fails closed and no global rollback exists.
Semantic token/typography/forced-color and dialog-focus behavior are pinned without remote assets.
Domain surfaces map SR/RFC/Objectives/Inventory/Infrastructure/Settings back to owner packets rather than copying truth.
LLD-09 CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider is exact and read-only; LLD-12 deliberate-action provider/routes and session+Host+Origin+CSRF handshake are exact.
Construction tests comprise 55 acceptance and 25 failure cases.

Exact-head LLD Spec Integrity run 34069682015 at commit 98fa6123cd1ab4365ef99ab47f2d6bfb3645faaf completed successfully with zero LLD-10 BLOCKER/HIGH findings; remaining global findings are confined to LLD-01..07 retrofit work.
design_principle: The UI may preserve context, working intent and presentation state, but only owning-domain commands can change accepted operational truth.
